Approved community members (18+, photo ID) apply online, then staff schedule a daytime outing with one shelter dog: pickup 9-11am, return same day by 6pm Mon-Fri or 5pm Sat. Leash in public, pet-friendly places only, no dog parks. Shelter at 5203 Watauga Rd; 817-656-9614.

Thinking of adopting? See Watauga Animal Services Center on ShelterAdoption for its adoptable pets and adoption events.

Rules, hours and fees are set by the shelter and can change. Always confirm with the shelter before you go. ShelterDayOut isn't affiliated with this shelter and doesn't arrange outings.
